Asha: Hi all — new manager (platform infra) starts Mon. Need a tiny manager+HR checklist, a one-paragraph welcome week blurb I can paste into the offer, and a simple 30/60/90 outcomes list. Also who handles building badge and KMS access?

Ravi: Congrats! Short checklist: preboard (Day -2): laptop & Okta invite; Day 1 AM: People Ops intro (payroll/benefits) + manager 30m welcome; Day 1 PM: IT access sweep (Github, VPN, Okta); Day 2: buddy pairing for env + run smoke test; Week 1: schedule 30m readout.

Maya: Who to ping: badge/parking -> Facilities (Facilities); KMS/VPN -> security (#security-ops) or ping me; repo access -> eng-admin or Ravi.

Asha: Can you write the one-paragraph welcome blurb please, candidate-facing?

Ravi: Paste this: "Welcome week (short): Day 1 well do People Ops onboarding and a manager welcome, followed by an IT/access check and a relaxed team lunch. Day 2 youll pair with your assigned buddy to set up dev & run the onboarding smoke test. Day 3 contains short security and infra walkthroughs. Day 4 is time for a small hands-on task (first PR), and Day 5 is a 30-minute wrap with your manager to align on 30-day priorities."

Maya: 30/60/90 bullets to include in the offer: 30 days -> stable access, merged first small change, 1:1 rhythm set; 60 days -> owning a small infra improvement, runbooks updated; 90 days -> leading cross-team delivery and mentoring new hires.

IT Bot: Preboard note: laptop order placed, Okta invite scheduled for 2026-03-25 08:00 UTC. Please confirm shipping address.

Asha: Great — Facilities, can you prep a temporary badge for first week (onsite Wed/Thu)?

Facilities: Will do. Need preferred onsite days and a mobile number. Sending brief form now.

Asha: Thanks everyone. Ill DM phone and onsite days, and paste the paragraph into the offer. Closing loop.
